Straightforward tools for exploring financial figures and making the effect of different choices easier to understand.

Turn financial figures into something useful

Financial decisions often become clearer when the numbers can be explored rather than treated as a fixed headline figure. This section contains small tools I have put together to compare scenarios, expose the effect of changing assumptions and make everyday calculations easier to reason about.

These tools are intended to support exploration and understanding rather than replace professional financial advice. Browse the available analyses below and adjust the inputs to see how the results change.
